title: Unify triage across the three repos under the dedicated triage seat — sister-repo whole-seats narrow to execution seats
body:
Maintainer direct-ruling card, filed and claimed by the skills seat (session `session_017TNzEetykdh7ceZGwuAPLq`). Provenance (2026-08-16, live PM session): the maintainer asked 「是否建议分诊应该统一收归分诊PM」; presented with the seat's recommendation (unify — merging two already-ruled models: objectstack's 纵向拆分 2026-08-05 + the queue steward's 三仓一座 2026-08-06 precedent with pre-registered split triggers), the maintainer ruled, verbatim:

> 同意派发(fable,SKILL.md)。

## Measured motivation (this shift)

`pm:on-hold` means different things in two repos (objectstack migrated, objectui did not); objectui carries a **76-card ungraded finding backlog** vs objectstack's zero; the seam-card dead-letter incident traced to routing assumptions split across seats; the auto-adjudication authority boundary for sister-repo seats was textually ambiguous and never exercised.

## Deliverable (one PR, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` only)

1. **多仓协调 rule 4 rewrite**: the dedicated triage seat becomes the **sole triage/grading/routing/type producer for all three repos**; sister-repo `repo:*` seats narrow to **execution seats** — claim/dispatch/review/land in their own repo, trust labels, never mint `domain:*`/type/grades, report mislabels (word-for-word the discipline objectstack execution seats already follow). The skills-lane finding self-grading exception stays as-is.
2. **分诊座位职责 sections extended to three repos**: backlog sweep, first-touch grading (budgeted), release-board production, dedup/shadow checks, and the 代裁通道 now read across objectstack + objectui + cloud; **auto-adjudication authority is exclusively this unified seat's** (this dissolves the sister-seat A/B ambiguity — centralized control AND authority-follows-duty in one stroke).
3. **Split trigger pre-registered** (queue-steward precedent, verbatim shape): round length approaching the fire period, or one repo consistently starved by priority ordering ⇒ split by repo — recorded so scale-out is a documented exit, not a redesign.
4. **Post-merge steps named, not performed here**: objectui/cloud seat posts' 范围 lines updated by their own seats (cross-seat notices); the triage Routine's environment must carry three-repo sources (the steward Routine's env is the precedent — if a Routines-UI tweak is needed it is the maintainer's one click, listed in the PR body); the objectui 76-finding backlog is the unified seat's first graded batch (also discharging the pending objectui migration ruling).

## Constraints

fable-mandatory (`--tier` derived and quoted); SKILL.md at 685/686 (headroom 1 post-wave-2) — fund by compression, headroom ≤1; 中文行文, machine literals English; id-lint (no issue numbers in operational text); ADR-class ⇒ draft PR, `Fixes` this card, `skip-changeset`, human merge only.

## Serial position

`SKILL.md` hot chain: **behind the translation wave-2 PR currently awaiting the maintainer's merge** — dispatch fires automatically on its merge event.
